subject: Pricing packet & NDA — hosted API baseline and versioned rate card
messages:
From: Elena Park <ep@novatech.io>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novatech.io
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: baseline hosted pricing & NDA

Hi Rishi,

We are evaluating hosted inference providers and would like Redwood's baseline hosted API pricing for an expected starting volume of ~100M tokens/month. Procurement will need a mutual NDA before we can exchange detailed usage numbers and run a short PoC.

Could you:
- Share your standard NDA (PDF) for signature
- Provide a baseline rate card (hosted API) or a short note on packaging tiers and commit discounts (if any)
- Confirm whether you can do a 12-month committed discount and rough % ranges for 100M/month

I'm copying our procurement contact (procurement@novatech.io). Ideally we'd get the NDA signed this week.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
NovaTech

--
(attachment: none)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <ep@novatech.io>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: baseline hosted pricing & NDA

Hi Elena — great to hear from you, and thanks for the clear ask.

I attached our standard mutual NDA (Redwood_NDA_v2026-09-09.pdf) for review. If that looks good, we can send a DocuSign link or accept a signed PDF.

For the rate card: would you prefer a short summary (baseline bullets) first, or the full rate card PDF after the NDA is in place? I can do both — baseline bullets now and the versioned PDF after the NDA is signed.

Quick baseline (hosted API):
- Pay-as-you-go: $0.007 / 1K inference tokens (baseline)
- Embeddings: $0.002 / 1K embedding tokens
- 12-month commit (100M tokens/mo): typically 10–20% discount depending on commitment level and retention SLA
- Reserved throughput options and burst packages available for predictable latency

I copied Lauren (Sales Manager) to keep her in the loop on packaging/discount guidance.

Next steps:
1) Please sign the attached NDA or tell me if you want DocuSign.
2) I'll send the versioned rate card PDF (internal-controlled v1.2) once NDA is confirmed.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Redwood_NDA_v2026-09-09.pdf)

From: Elena Park <ep@novatech.io>

Cc: NovaTech Procurement <procurement@novatech.io>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: baseline hosted pricing & NDA

Thanks Rishi — procurement prefers DocuSign. I've asked them to expect the link.

A few clarifications on the baseline:
- The 100M tokens/month is our forecast for the PoC; we may scale to 300–400M if performance and cost profile look good.
- For discounts: procurement will need a breakdown of the discount schedule (e.g., 12mo 10% / 24mo 18% / committed throughput tiers).
- Can you confirm whether Redwood's hosted pricing includes KV cache / prefix caching by default or whether that is an add-on?

Procurement will sign the NDA once they receive the DocuSign link. Please copy procurement@novatech.io on the signature request.

Elena

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: NovaTech pricing requests — draft rate card + sign-off

Rishi / Lauren — filing a draft to send once NDA is back. Attached is the curated hosted rate card for baseline customers (hosted_ratecard_baseline_v1.2.pdf). Notes:
- v1.0 was internal baseline; v1.2 adds a 12/24mo discount ladder and clarifies that prefix/KV caching is included in hosted plans (no extra fee).
- Suggested commercial offer for 100M tokens/mo: 12-month commit at 12% discount + 2% usage rebate for first 3 months if we hit >110% forecast.
- If procurement presses for deeper discount, propose a blended reserved capacity quote under Redwood Dedicated — can be helpful but requires a longer lead time.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/8421 (RDW-8421-NVT) — include legal on the final DocuSign.

Priyom
Head of Pricing Ops (internal note)

Subject: Re: Request: baseline hosted pricing & NDA

Hi Elena & procurement team — thanks for the quick turnaround.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/example-signing/8421 (sent to procurement@novatech.io)

We've received the executed NDA back (attached as Redwood_NDA_signed_NovaTech_2026-09-11.pdf). As promised, attached is the versioned rate card PDF (hosted_ratecard_baseline_v1.2.pdf). A few highlights and next steps below:

Highlights (from v1.2):
- Baseline hosted inference: $0.007 / 1K inference tokens (pay-as-you-go)
- Commit tiers: 12mo — 10–14% (typical); 24mo — 16–20% (typical). For 100M tokens/mo we've proposed 12% for a 12mo commit in the attachment.
- Prefix/KV caching: included in hosted plans; accelerates throughput and is transparent in billing (no separate SKU).
- Rebate incentive: 2% credit applied to account if usage exceeds forecast by >10% in first 3 months (pilot incentive).

Attachments included:
- Redwood_NDA_signed_NovaTech_2026-09-11.pdf (executed mutual NDA)
- hosted_ratecard_baseline_v1.2.pdf (version-controlled, internal id: v1.2)

Next steps:
1) Procurement / legal: confirm the DocuSign receipt and that the executed NDA is acceptable.
2) Commercial call: I'd like to schedule a 30-min call with procurement + technical lead to walk the rate card and discuss commit level. Are you available Wed 9/16 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 9/17 11:00–11:30 PT?

If procurement needs a redlined change to the NDA, please have procurement@novatech.io send marked-up PDF and loop in Redwood Legal (legal@redwood.ai).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
